name: wheel-list
summary: An iOS alarm-style picker whose rows curve away on a 3D cylinder.
props: Custom row; `active` is the row in the band.
Rows visible at once (odd numbers centre the band).
Degrees each row curves away from the band.
Text colour of default rows — white on a photo or dark panel.
Colour of the surface behind the wheel; rows fade into it top and bottom.
What the wheel picks, for screen readers.
behavior: Flick to spin and it snaps to a row; tap a row to scroll it into the band.
Each row rotates, scales and fades by its distance from the band, interpolated from the scroll position on the native driver.
One adjustable element with increment / decrement actions; its value is the selected label, or "3 / 12" for custom rows.
Browsers lack snap momentum, so it settles on the nearest row shortly after scrolling stops.
